query_analysis.original_query: Please provide the thermodynamic data related to azeotropes existing in natural gas processing columns.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Obtain thermodynamic data on azeotropic mixtures present in natural gas processing columns, including phase equilibria and operational conditions.

clarification_questions: Are there specific components or mixtures in the natural gas stream for which you need azeotropic data?
What are the operating conditions (temperature and pressure) in your processing columns?
